description: Source code implementing the DeferGlobalInitializers functionality for shader AST transformation, moving global initializers into a separate function called at program start.

methods.name: GetDeferredInitializers
methods.description: Processes a declaration node to defer initialization of non-constant globals and prepare deferred initializers.

methods.name: InsertInitCallToMain
methods.description: Inserts a call to the global initialization function at the start of main() in the shader AST.

methods.name: DeferGlobalInitializers
methods.description: Main function that traverses global declarations, defers initializers, and modifies the AST accordingly.
